![Screenshot 2026-10-08 at 2.45.10 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2J0c8RLanP847XYkqwxvmgSrUJkjKR4G/cc3c1f27e2341bbc8e1f65e24841e0f11895a2062f6f8222874215795334b1bb.png)
AI Overview

Today, I took my first real step into hardware by spending two hours researching PCB design as a complete beginner. I started with the absolute basics, learning the difference between a schematic diagram and the actual physical board layout. Figuring out concepts like traces, vias, and the significance of different board layers felt like learning a whole new language. I also explored popular design software, downloading KiCad after reading that it is highly recommended for beginners. By the end of my session, the initial overwhelm shifted into genuine excitement. I cannot wait to start routing my very first simple circuit.
